player_prompt.intro:
Marhaba s Lights Out! Kedes a {size}x{size} taɣda n tifawt.
Alɣal-ik a imɣas akked tifawt akkʷ OFF (yettemɣayen s yal '.').
Mikɛl daɣ kkesɣel tawlaɣt, ad tettirir tawlaɣt annet d tawlaɣt n tɣenawt nnes (sufel/lmɛal/sufɛl/ɣer lmɛal).
Tira [row col] ad tekkesɣel tawlaɣt (0-yettwaɣḍen, iɣef yella wakud n 0-{max_index}).
Kedes aɣʷ {max_turns} imɣasen ad tesegemt tɣemsa.
Asalɣem: 'O' = tawlaɣt yettɣama, '.' = tawlaɣt yettɣim

board.current_state:
Aḍṛis aɣli n tawla (Tikli {moves_made}, {moves_left} n tikliwin walanin, {completion}% yemyaḍen):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asenfel ar tettuɣal s waṭas ɣer [row col] deg tama n yiri d yilel s waṭas ɣer 0 d ṭṭfen {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Izirigiyen igan ad yiliyen seg 0 ar {max_index}. Tekkeb [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Afarha! Tesul tawḍa s {moves_used} n tikliwin!
